text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 大家好,欢迎收听《Real Easy English》,
zh_hant: 大家好,歡迎收聽《Real Easy English》,

text: the podcast where we have real conversations
zh: 在这个播客里,我们用简单的英语
zh_hant: 在這個播客裡,我們用簡單的英語

text: in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 进行真实的对话,帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 進行真實的對話,幫助你學習。

text: I’m Georgie.
And I'm Neil, and don't forget that this podcast is now available
zh: 我是Neil,别忘了这个播客现在
zh_hant: 我是Neil,別忘了這個播客現在

text: as a video on our website,
zh: 也可以在我们的网站上看视频版了,
zh_hant: 也可以在我們的網站上看影片版了,

text: so you can watch us at bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi, Neil.
How are you today?
Hi, Georgie.
I'm very well, actually.
I'm really happy today
because the Sun is shining, and it's warm,
zh: 因为阳光明媚,天气也很暖和,
zh_hant: 因為陽光明媚,天氣也很暖和,

text: and it seems like it's been a long time
since we had such nice sunny weather.
zh: 没有这样晴朗的好天气了。
zh_hant: 沒有這樣晴朗的好天氣了。

text: I know, the changing of the seasons is so wonderful,
zh: 是啊,季节的变化真是太美妙了,
zh_hant: 是啊,季節的變化真是太美妙了,

text: and actually, that's what we're talking about today.
zh: 其实,这正是我们今天要聊的话题,
zh_hant: 其實,這正是我們今天要聊的話題,

text: we're going to talk about the seasons
and the different types of weather we get in the UK.
zh: 以及英国不同类型的天气。
zh_hant: 以及英國不同型別的天氣。

text: Yes.
So in the UK
we, our seasons are roughly like this.
zh: 我们的四季大致是这样划分的。
zh_hant: 我們的四季大致是這樣劃分的。

text: So March, April,
May those are the spring seasons.
Then we move into summer, which is June, July and August.
zh: 然后是夏季,也就是六月、七月和八月。
zh_hant: 然後是夏季,也就是六月、七月和八月。

text: Autumn, that's September, October, November.
zh: 秋季是九月、十月、十一月。
zh_hant: 秋季是九月、十月、十一月。

text: And then we're into winter for December, January, February.
zh: 然后十二月、一月、二月就是冬季了。
zh_hant: 然後十二月、一月、二月就是冬季了。

text: Yeah.
More or less.
Approximately.
Yeah.
So, Neil, what is your favourite season?
zh: 那么Neil,你最喜欢哪个季节?
zh_hant: 那麼Neil,你最喜歡哪個季節?

text: Well, you can probably guess because I'm so happy
zh: 你大概能猜到,因为我这么开心,
zh_hant: 你大概能猜到,因為我這麼開心,

text: that it's spring and summer combined.
zh: 说明是春夏交替的时候。
zh_hant: 說明是春夏交替的時候。

text: So anything with long late
nights and evenings I love.
zh: 夜晚和傍晚的季节,我都喜欢。
zh_hant: 夜晚和傍晚的季節,我都喜歡。

text: What else is good about summer?
In the summer, you can be outside.
You can go swimming in the sea.
You can stay up late
and you have wonderful light in the UK.
zh: 而且英国的夏天光线特别美。
zh_hant: 而且英國的夏天光線特別美。

text: What's your favourite season then, Georgie?
zh: 那你最喜欢哪个季节呢,Georgie?
zh_hant: 那你最喜歡哪個季節呢,Georgie?

text: Well, I'm a big fan of the seasons,
zh: 嗯,我特别喜欢过渡性的季节。
zh_hant: 嗯,我特別喜歡過渡性的季節。

text: the transition seasons.
zh: 就是那种季节交替的时候。
zh_hant: 就是那種季節交替的時候。

text: So I really like spring and autumn,
zh: 所以我很喜欢春天和秋天,
zh_hant: 所以我很喜歡春天和秋天,

text: especially spring.
Right now we're in spring in the UK,
and you can see everyone
looking happier because
zh: 看起来都更开心了,因为
zh_hant: 看起來都更開心了,因為

text: we've had a really long, hard,
zh: 我们经历了一个漫长、艰难、
zh_hant: 我們經歷了一個漫長、艱難、

text: dark, cold winter
and everyone is smiling now because
zh: 现在大家都在微笑,因为
zh_hant: 現在大家都在微笑,因為

text: they there are blossoms on the trees
which make me so happy.
I love seeing pink blossoms on the trees.
zh: 我喜欢看树上粉色的花。
zh_hant: 我喜歡看樹上粉色的花。

text: The days are warmer and, yeah,
there's this sense of a transition.
Same with autumn.
Although you're leaving the summer months,
I really love the colours on the trees
zh: 但我真的很喜欢树上的颜色,
zh_hant: 但我真的很喜歡樹上的顏色,

text: as well.
Especially those cooler, crisp days
zh: 尤其是那种凉爽清新的日子,
zh_hant: 尤其是那種涼爽清新的日子,

text: when the sky is blue and the leaves
are orange and brown.
I love that.
Wow.
You're making me look forward to autumn, and it's not even summer yet.
zh: 你都让我开始期待秋天了,现在夏天都还没到呢。
zh_hant: 你都讓我開始期待秋天了,現在夏天都還沒到呢。

text: Is there a season that you don't like?
zh: 有没有你不喜欢的季节?
zh_hant: 有沒有你不喜歡的季節?

text: I do like all the seasons.
zh: 其实我每个季节都喜欢。
zh_hant: 其實我每個季節都喜歡。

text: I like to have balance,
so I wouldn't like to have summer all year round,
zh: 所以我不希望一年到头都是夏天,
zh_hant: 所以我不希望一年到頭都是夏天,

text: but I think,
winter is my least favourite because
zh: 冬天是我最不喜欢的季节,因为
zh_hant: 冬天是我最不喜歡的季節,因為

text: of the dark days.
In the UK I think it's particularly hard
zh: 我觉得在英国这一点尤其难熬,
zh_hant: 我覺得在英國這一點尤其難熬,

text: because,
especially January and February,
it's really cold
and there's nothing really to get us
through the the sad times.
zh: 帮我们熬过那些低落的时光。
zh_hant: 幫我們熬過那些低落的時光。

text: I know exactly what you mean.
There are good things about winter,
but mostly it's just difficult, isn't it?
zh: 但大多数时候真的挺难熬的,对吧?
zh_hant: 但大多數時候真的挺難熬的,對吧?

text: I agree.
It's the dark.
I can't stand it.
Yeah.
So, as I said,
I quite like having the balance of different seasons
zh: 我挺喜欢一年四季的这种平衡感,
zh_hant: 我挺喜歡一年四季的這種平衡感,

text: throughout the year.
I like to have transitions and changes.
What about you, Neil?
How do you feel about that?
Yeah, I think I agree.
I mean, it would be nice to have a shorter winter,
zh: 我是说,如果冬天能短一点会更好,
zh_hant: 我是說,如果冬天能短一點會更好,

text: but I think I would still prefer to have different seasons
zh: 但我觉得我还是更喜欢有不同的季节,
zh_hant: 但我覺得我還是更喜歡有不同的季節,

text: because,
like I said, I really like the late
zh: 就像我说的,我真的很喜欢夏天里
zh_hant: 就像我說的,我真的很喜歡夏天裡

text: light
evenings in the summer.
And I think even though I hate the dark winters,
zh: 而且我觉得,虽然我讨厌黑暗的冬天,
zh_hant: 而且我覺得,雖然我討厭黑暗的冬天,

text: I would really miss that if the weather was nice all year,
zh: 但如果一年到头天气都很好,
zh_hant: 但如果一年到頭天氣都很好,

text: but got dark at the same time, like at six or seven o'clock.
zh: 却在六七点就天黑了,我一定会很怀念冬天的。
zh_hant: 卻在六七點就天黑了,我一定會很懷念冬天的。

text: OK, let's recap the language we heard in the conversation.
zh: 好了,让我们回顾一下对话中出现的表达。
zh_hant: 好了,讓我們回顧一下對話中出現的表達。

text: We learned different ways to talk about the seasons.
zh: 我们学到了几种谈论季节的说法。
zh_hant: 我們學到了幾種談論季節的說法。

text: For example, looking forward to that means
zh: 比如,looking forward to 的意思是
zh_hant: 比如,looking forward to 的意思是

text: you're excited for something to happen in the future.
zh: 你对未来即将发生的事感到期待。
zh_hant: 你對未來即將發生的事感到期待。

text: That's right.
So I'm really looking forward to the warm,
zh: 所以我真的很期待夏天那些
zh_hant: 所以我真的很期待夏天那些

text: light, sunny evenings in the summer.
zh: 温暖、明亮、阳光灿烂的傍晚。
zh_hant: 溫暖、明亮、陽光燦爛的傍晚。

text: We heard to be a big fan of that means that you really like something.
zh: 我们还听到 be a big fan of,意思是你非常喜欢某样东西。
zh_hant: 我們還聽到 be a big fan of,意思是你非常喜歡某樣東西。

text: For example, I'm a big fan of spring and autumn.
zh: 比如,I'm a big fan of spring and autumn(我特别喜欢春天和秋天)。
zh_hant: 比如,I'm a big fan of spring and autumn(我特別喜歡春天和秋天)。

text: Yes, Georgie is a big fan of the transition seasons.
zh: 是的,Georgie特别喜欢那些过渡性的季节。
zh_hant: 是的,Georgie特別喜歡那些過渡性的季節。

text: I'm not such a big fan of winter, though.
I, actually, I can't stand it,
which means that I really hate it.
zh: 意思就是我真的很讨厌它。
zh_hant: 意思就是我真的很討厭它。

text: Thanks for listening to Real Easy English.
We've talked about the seasons in the UK,
but the seasons are different all around the world.
zh: 但世界各地的季节都各不相同。
zh_hant: 但世界各地的季節都各不相同。

text: What are the seasons like where you live?
zh: 你所在的地方,季节是什么样的呢?
zh_hant: 你所在的地方,季節是什麼樣的呢?

text: Email us at learningenglish@bbc.co.uk.
zh: 欢迎发邮件到learningenglish@bbc.co.uk联系我们。
zh_hant: 歡迎發郵件到learningenglish@bbc.co.uk聯絡我們。

text: We always like to hear from you.
zh: 我们一直很期待收到你的来信。
zh_hant: 我們一直很期待收到你的來信。

text: In the next episode, we talk about what life was like when we were children.
zh: 下一集,我们会聊聊我们小时候的生活是什么样的。
zh_hant: 下一集,我們會聊聊我們小時候的生活是什麼樣的。

text: Join us then.
Goodbye.
Bye.
